item.name: List active tasks filtered by project

exec: pm.test('Only active tasks from the requested project are returned', function () { pm.expect(response).to.be.an('array'); response.forEach((task) => { pm.expect(task.projectId).to.equal(Number(pm.environment.get('projectId'))); pm.expect(task.isDone).to.equal(false); }); });
pm.test('Other-user task is excluded', function () { pm.expect(response.map((task) => String(task.id))).not.to.include(pm.environment.get('taskIdB')); });
pm.test('Only completed tasks are returned', function () { pm.expect(response).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; response.forEach((task) => pm.expect(task.isDone).to.equal(true)); });
pm.test('Page one honors page size', function () { pm.expect(response).to.be.an('array').with.length(1); });

pm.test('Page two honors page size and advances results', function () { pm.expect(response).to.be.an('array').with.length(1); pm.expect(String(response[0].id)).not.to.equal(pm.environment.get('firstPageTaskId')); });
pm.test('Response is the requested task', function () { pm.expect(String(response.id)).to.equal(pm.environment.get('taskId')); pm.expect(response.title).to.equal('Postman primary task'); });

item.name: Filter tasks by priority and label

exec: pm.test('Both filters match the task', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some((task) => String(task.id) === pm.environment.get('orgTaskId'))).to.equal(true); });

item.name: Filtering by unused label returns empty list

exec: pm.test('No tasks match the unused label', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });

pm.test('Tasks are sorted by descending priority', function () { const order = { low: 1, medium: 2, high: 3 }; const tasks = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(tasks).to.be.an('array'); for (let i = 1; i < tasks.length; i++) { pm.expect(order[tasks[i - 1].priority]).to.be.at.least(order[tasks[i].priority]); if (tasks[i - 1].priority === tasks[i].priority) pm.expect(tasks[i - 1].id).to.be.at.most(tasks[i].id); } });
pm.test('The remaining label stays attached', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().labels).to.have.lengthOf(1); });

item.name: Detaching the same label again is safe
Delete an attached label without deleting the task
Task-label link is removed by label deletion

exec: pm.test('Task remains and the deleted label is detached', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.equal(Number(pm.environment.get('orgTaskId'))); pm.expect(pm.response.json().labels).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });

item.name: Delete label without deleting the task

exec: pm.test('Task still exists without labels', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.equal(Number(pm.environment.get('orgTaskId'))); pm.expect(pm.response.json().labels).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });
